description: This file defines the Java entity class `Book` for a book-tracking application. It includes properties for book details like title, author, genre, publishers, reading status, and related annotations for ORM (Hibernate JPA) and serialization. It also contains utility methods for managing relationships and formatting editions.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: Entity class representing a book with properties, relationships, and utility methods for managing book details, relationships, and formatting.

methods.name: convertToBookEdition
methods.description: Converts an integer edition number to a formatted string with the appropriate ordinal suffix (e.g., '1st edition').

methods.name: setEdition
methods.description: Sets the edition field with a formatted string based on the integer input.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a Tag to the book and updates the Tag's book list.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a Tag from the book and updates the Tag's book list.

methods.name: addPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Associates a predefined shelf with the book and adds the book to the shelf.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelf
methods.description: Disassociates the shelf from the book and updates the shelf's book list.

methods.name: removeAuthor
methods.description: Removes the author association from the book and updates the author's book list.

methods.name: setPublicationYear
methods.description: Sets the publication year of the book.

methods.name: addGenre
methods.description: Adds a genre to the book's genre set.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher to the book's publisher set and updates the publisher’s book list.

methods.name: removePublisher
methods.description: Removes a publisher from the book and updates the publisher’s book list.
